scripts.generate: npm run generate:go && npm run generate:ts
scripts.check:frontend: npm --prefix frontend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend test -- --run && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.migrate:up: docker compose -f docker-compose.local.yml run --rm --no-deps backend /app/bin/migrate up
scripts.migrate:status: docker compose -f docker-compose.local.yml run --rm --no-deps backend /app/bin/migrate status
scripts.migrate:down: docker compose -f docker-compose.local.yml run --rm --no-deps backend /app/bin/migrate down
